process_edit_prompts: run the script to process edit prompts from new_task_release.json and merge into edit_full.json
download_sources: download dreambench and dreambooth source datasets using the download_sources function
build_dreambench_image_mapping: build a mapping from multi-image naming to dreambench source paths using build_dreambench_image_mapping
build_dreambooth_image_mapping: build a mapping from subject name to dreambooth source paths using build_dreambooth_image_mapping
process_image_path: process an image path and return the new relative path using process_image_path
